_about: Trainers and townsfolk for each painted town (docs/world/WORLD_POPULATION_RULES.md). tools/place_trainers.py places them on the map; teams come from progression.json areas at run time.

dustara: Kid: The drift grass crackles with blue sparks. That's how you know Alienmon are hiding in it!
Old prospector: The Starfall crater glows purple every night since the pods came down.
Mechanic: Press B to hop gaps. Saves you the long way around the canyon.
ferrox: Scrapper: Everything here is built from junk. Even the Relay Tower.
Rail hand: Alloy-types love the rail yard. Bring something that burns.
Kid: Hank's Alienmon are tough as old boilers!
sporeholm: Spore tender: Mind the lily pads. Some float farther than they look.
Botanist: The mushrooms glow brighter near the Relay Tower.
Bog hiker: Toxin-types hide in the moss reeds. Carry Cure Spray.
thalassa: Sailor: The docks go on for miles. Jump the short gaps between piers.
Swimmer: Hydro-types shine here. Volt moves send them flying.
Dockhand: Helix boats were circling the harbor again last night.
neonis: Raver: The whole city hums with Volt energy. Feel it?
Coder: Every sign in Neonis runs on Alienmon power.
Courier: Deliveries are faster across the catwalks.
glyphos: Archaeologist: These glyphs tell the Alienmon's story. Read the murals.
Pilgrim: The obelisk hums when you hold Signal Shards near it.
Rune scholar: Crystal-types grow in the old courtyards.
pyros: Miner: The lava's hot enough to melt a mine cart. Stay on the trestles.
Smith: Magma-types forge their own armor down here.
Ash walker: The crater's light still flickers after all these years.
glacia: Researcher: Something huge is frozen inside the glacier wall.
Climber: Ice paths are slick. Jump the cracks, don't walk them.
Radio tech: Our antennas pick up signals from the Starfall Rift.
helix: Scientist: I just run the tests. Don't look at me like that.
Guard: Keep moving. Visitors aren't supposed to be on this deck.
Engineer: The power cores have been running hot all week.
halo: Pilgrim: The holo-globe shows all fourteen worlds at once.
Skywatcher: The islands float on updrafts. Don't look down.
Mystic: The twins see what you'll do before you do it.
umbra: Scavenger: Gravewell was a city once, before it tipped into the sinkhole.
Lantern keeper: Keep to the lanterns. The dark plays tricks.
Drifter: Void-types only come out where the light can't reach.
starfall: Rift seeker: Can you hear it? The crater hums like a heartbeat.
Star watcher: Crystals here grow overnight.
Rig worker: Helix left half its drills running when they ran.
apex: Astronomer: The great telescope can see all the way to Ystra.
Summit guard: Only the strongest Linkers make it this high.
Ace Linker: Train hard. The summit doesn't forgive.
ystra: Ystran echo: ...welcome home, children of the stars...
Rift walker: Every fragment here was one world, once.
Seeker: The crystal forest sings when the Seedmother wakes.
